units.source_text: 我们一回来，看见舞女已洗去脸上的脂粉，

en.t: When we came back, we saw that the dancing girl had already washed the powder and rouge from her face,

units.source_text: 蹲在路旁抚摸着小狗的头。

en.t: and was crouching by the roadside, stroking the little dog's head.

units.source_text: 我想回到自己的房间去，便说：

en.t: I wanted to go back to my own room, so I said:
